instruction: In the spreadsheet, find the maximum value in column A (from A2 to A20) and enter it as a formula in cell D2.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the maximum value in column A (A2:A20) and entering it as a formula in cell D2. Verified with Python: max of column A = 1.9 (at row 20). Evaluator reads cell D2 value after saving and compares against expected 1.9.

Metric validates formula pattern using regex (lines 38-44), ensuring formula matches '=MAX\(A2:A20\)' pattern exactly
Metric verifies calculated value equals expected 1.9 with tolerance (lines 58-63)
Complete coverage: All requirements verified - formula existence, correct formula pattern (MAX with A2:A20 range), and correct calculated result
